name: hxn-gpu
description: One GPU API for Haxe over the hx-n drivers: Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, OpenGL ES, WebGPU and WebGL2, with features and limits per device
releasenote: First release: one GPU API over the hx-n drivers for Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, OpenGL ES, WebGPU and WebGL2, with features and limits per device, a default backend per platform with overrides and a warning on fallback, hxnsl shaders for every backend, and one barrier tracker for Vulkan and Direct3D 12.
